column1: # NOTHING IN THIS FILE WAS MEASURED BY THIS REPO. NO 16 GB MACHINE WAS USED.
# Sources, all from the MTPLX 2.12.0 release notes (2026-09-24) and the pack's
#   ctx        20480   MTPLX's memory plan for this pack on a 16 GB Mac
#   need_mib   8909    8.70 GiB peak at a 15K-token context, measured by the
#                      MTPLX author on an M5 Max
# EXTRAPOLATED: need_mib is a peak taken at 15K tokens, applied here to a
# 20,480-token profile. The extra ~5K tokens of KV cache is not counted, so
# treat it as a floor. It was not taken on 16 GB hardware.
# EXTRAPOLATED: max_tokens 8192 is this repo's choice, not a measurement --
# see OUTPUT_LIMIT in config.sh for the reasoning.
# effort is "default" because the pack's chat template has no reasoning-effort
# No throughput columns: no tok/s figure exists for this pack from anyone.
coding|20480|2|default|8192|8909|default; MTPLX's 16 GB plan -- 20k ctx, depth 2. NOTHING MEASURED on 16 GB
